name: factlot
description: FactLot: the open fact layer for commercial real estate AI agents.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.schemas: node --experimental-strip-types --conditions=factlot-source scripts/gen-schemas.ts && prettier --write spec/schemas >/dev/null && rm -rf python/src/factlot/schemas && cp -r spec/schemas python/src/factlot/schemas
scripts.schemas:check: npm run schemas && git diff --exit-code spec/schemas python/src/factlot/schemas
scripts.test:python: cd python && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
